title: Optimized QIAGEN DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit Protocol for Environmental DNA Extraction
author: Marion Chevrinais
materials: Install all the material on the benchtop including microtubes, reagents and collection tubes from the QIAGEN DNeasy Blood and Tissue Kit, and racks.

steps.title: Prepare Workspace and Materials
steps.instruction: Set up the benchtop with all necessary materials and clean the area.

substeps.instruction: Install 2 mL microtubes with Lyse&Spin baskets, pre-identified 2 mL Eppendorf Safe-Lock tubes, tweezers, scissors, nacelles, waste beaker, microtube opener, and gloves.
Clean the bench with water, 0.6% sodium hypochlorite solution, and water before use.

steps.title: Process Filter Samples
steps.instruction: Divide the filter and allocate portions for extraction and backup.

substeps.instruction: Using clean tweezers, take a filter above a clean nacelle, unfold it, and cut it in half with clean scissors, attempting to divide the filtrate equally.
Roll one filter half (filtrate inside) and place it into a 2 mL microtube with a Lyse&Spin basket using clean tweezers.
Store the extraction microtube at room temperature if extracting the same day, or at -20 °C if extracting on a subsequent day.
Roll the second filter half with tweezers, place it in a pre-identified 2 mL Eppendorf Safe-Lock tube, and store as a backup at -80 °C.
Rinse tweezers, scissors, and nacelle with water, 0.6% hypochlorite bleach, water, and ethanol 96-100%.
Change gloves and repeat for each filter.

steps.title: Lysis and Digestion
steps.instruction: Perform chemical and enzymatic lysis of the filtrate under an extractor hood.

substeps.instruction: Change gloves and work under an extractor hood or arm due to proteinase K.
Add 450 µL of ATL solution to each microtube.
Add 50 µL of proteinase K to each microtube.
Mix by inversion for a few seconds, ensuring the filter remains immersed.
Incubate in a thermomixer for a minimum of 02:00:00 at 56 °C with shaking at 900 rpm.
Centrifuge microtubes at 18,000 g for 00:01:00. If lysis solution remains in the column, repeat centrifugation until all solution has passed through.

steps.title: Sample Preparation for Binding
steps.instruction: Prepare the lysate for DNA binding to the column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the eluate to a new labeled 2 mL microtube.
Add 500 µL of AL buffer to each microtube, changing pipette tips between tubes, and vortex.
Incubate in the thermomixer for 00:10:00 at 56 °C.
Add 500 µL of ethanol 96-100% to each microtube, changing pipette tips between tubes.
Mix by inversion for 00:00:15.

steps.title: DNA Binding and Washing
steps.instruction: Bind DNA to the DNeasy column and perform wash steps.

substeps.instruction: Pipet up to 690 µL of the mix into a DNeasy column placed in a 2 mL collection tube.
Centrifuge for 00:01:00 at 6,000 g; discard flow-through and collection tube.
Place the column in a new collection tube and repeat the centrifugation process until all solution has passed through the column.
Add 500 µL of AW1 buffer (change pipette tip between tubes) and centrifuge for 00:01:00 at 6,000 g; discard flow-through and collection tube.
Add 500 µL of AW2 buffer (change pipette tip between tubes) and centrifuge for 00:03:00 at 17,500 g; discard flow-through and collection tube.

steps.title: Column Drying and Elution
steps.instruction: Dry the column and elute the purified DNA.

substeps.instruction: Place the DNeasy column in a new collection tube and centrifuge at 17,500 g for 00:02:00 to dry the column.
Place the column into a 2 mL labeled Eppendorf Safe-Lock microtube.
Add 100 µL of EB buffer directly to the center of the membrane.
Incubate at room temperature for 00:05:00.
Discard the column.

steps.title: Storage and Cleanup
steps.instruction: Store the DNA extracts and perform a thorough decontamination of the workspace.

substeps.instruction: Store eluate at 4 °C for detections within 2 weeks, -20 °C for detections between 2 weeks and 3 months, or -80 °C for detections later than 3 months.
Dispose of liquid bench top trash into the laboratory liquid trash.
Rinse liquid bench top trash with water, discard, then clean with water, 0.6% sodium hypochlorite solution, and water.
Wipe down pipettes and centrifuges with water, 0.6% sodium hypochlorite solution, water, and ethanol.
Rinse microtube racks by spraying with 0.6% sodium hypochlorite solution and rinsing with water.
Clean the bench with water (Milli-Q), 0.6% sodium hypochlorite solution, and water after use.
